name: @covel/desktop-tauri
description: Tauri-based desktop shell for Covel (experimental, sits next to @covel/desktop).

scripts.build:mac:arm64: pnpm prepare:sidecar --target aarch64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin && node scripts/stage-release.mjs aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac:x64: pnpm prepare:sidecar --target x86_64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin && node scripts/stage-release.mjs x86_64-apple-darwin
